title: helictotrichon armeniacum
intro: Helictotrichon armeniacum, commonly known as Armenian wheat grass, is a type of grass belonging to the Poaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Armenian wheat grass are attributed to its ability to act as an antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that have been shown to possess potential therapeutic properties.
